The Legends Awaken! (Part 2)''' (Japanese: '''ソード＆シールド「最強の剣と盾」②''' ''Sword & Shield - The Ultimate Sword and Shield 2'') is the fourteenth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the {{pkmn|animated series}} episodes ''[[JN044|Sword and Shield: "From Here to Eternatus!"]]'' and ''[[JN045|Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!]]''. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Sonia]] learn the identities of {{p|Zacian}} and {{p|Zamazenta}}. * {{p|Eternatus}} emerges from the [[Energy Plant]] core, starting the [[Darkest Day]]. * Goh travels to [[Slumbering Weald]] and obtains the [[Rusted Sword]] and [[Rusted Shield]]. * Ash and Goh battle [[Rose]] and [[Oleana]] and win. * Ash's {{p|Riolu}} and Goh's {{p|Raboot}} [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{AP|Lucario}} and {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}}, respectively. * Eternatus turns into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Eternatus|Eternamax}} form. * Ash and Goh defeat Eternatus with Zacian and Zamazenta's help, allowing Goh to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} {{TP|Goh|Eternatus}} and end the Darkest Day. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Lucario}} * {{p|Cinderace}} * {{p|Eternatus}} * {{p|Charizard}} * {{p|Copperajah}} * {{p|Milotic}} * {{p|Zacian}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zacian and Zamazenta|Crowned Sword}}) * {{p|Zamazenta}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zacian and Zamazenta|Crowned Shield}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * {{an|Leon}} * [[Rose]] * [[Sonia]] * [[Oleana]] * [[Oleana's subordinate]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Riolu}} ({{OP|Ash|Riolu}};
